page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; in the right margin, beside the second paragraph, the section mark "X."; at the foot, the gathering signature "Aa ij".

main_text.l: qui divisus est à Christo, à Filio, & à Ver-
bo, quod non ab uno Deo Patre emanat,
ut nostrum, sed à Sige progreditur.
à Viri docti exceptionibus sic Vindi-
queat, quin ad Valentinum illiúsque hæ-
tor: contrarium sibi persuasum esse testa-
tur Vir doctus; tamen nè quis in animis
lus hæreat, & ne suos etiam Usserium,
esse credit, resumere ac confirmare sta-
tuit; adeò ut, si quis adhuc sit qui exi-sti-
mat Autorem ad hæresin quàm amplexus
est Valentinus collineasse, nè hoc quidem
enim tertiò, Hanc ipsam hæresin Valentino

page.notes: The page is a single column. The "X." in the right margin is a section mark. The printed "Vsserium" (Ussher) is read as "Usserium" under the u/v rule; the letters are a little worn. Some letters in the top lines are rubbed, but all words are legible.
